decision: Whether a transformer neural process, the strong successor of the 2018 conditional neural process, overtakes AnchorBoost on three-point reconstruction in the published screens.
comparators: Transformer Neural Process, deterministic variant (TNP-D), Nguyen & Grover, ICML 2022, official code github.com/tung-nd/TNP-pytorch commit 73df9225, MIT

Translation-equivariant TNP (TE-TNP-D) following Ashman et al., ICML 2024; github.com/cambridge-mlg/tnp main commit 8815cdc4 carries CNP/ANP/ConvCNP/TNP and no translation-equivariant model, so the TE construction is re-implemented here for one-dimensional inputs and is labelled as a re-implementation in every report
training_regime: Same as the published CNP comparison: fitted within each screen, meta-trained across that screen's training-fold chemicals, episodes sample k ~ U{0..min(5, L-1)} context levels and score the Gaussian NLL of every well, three seeds (0, 1, 2), 4,000 steps, batch 32, AdamW lr 1e-3 wd 1e-4, OneCycle with pct_start 0.1, gradient clipping 1.0, arithmetic mean of the three final-checkpoint predicted means.
splits: Unchanged published folds and designs. Network formation: train on every chemical whose fold differs from the test fold (development fold 0 included, as release/chip_forecast.py does), score folds 1-4, five seeded three-level designs per chemical. Acute and human neural: the frozen benchmarks/strong_baseline/external bundle, all five folds, same identity-clean populations and exclusions.
scoring: release/chip_forecast.py errors(): mean absolute error over observed held-out concentration-level means, averaged over the five designs within a chemical, then equally across chemicals. Identical metric, designs and masks as Fig. 2 of the manuscript.

hyperparameters.selection: Five candidate configurations, scored once each on the development partition (fold 0) with models trained on folds 1-4, exactly the procedure that selected AnchorBoost's settings. The best configuration of each family (TNP, TE-TNP) is frozen before any test fold is fitted. No test or calibration response enters selection.
candidates: tnpd_official: official configs/gp/tnpd.yaml sizes (d_model 64, emb_depth 4, feedforward 128, 4 heads, 6 layers, dropout 0)
tnpd_interp: same sizes plus the interpolation-gated decoder of the selected CNP configuration
tetnpd_interp: translation-equivariant attention with the interpolation gate
tetnpd_official: translation-equivariant attention without the gate

adaptations: A token carries [x, y*m, m] because the screens leave single (concentration, output) cells unmeasured; the CNP encoder receives the same block.
One learned context token is always present so that a zero-context episode has something to attend to; the official mask would make such a row all -inf.
Scale is 0.02 + softplus(s), the bound of the published CNP, instead of exp(s).
Output dimension is the screen's output count (68, 43 or 9).
endpoints: Three-point reconstruction MAE for TNP and TE-TNP in the network-formation screen (194 chemicals, folds 1-4) and, if they fit in budget, the acute (383 identities) and human neural (69 identities) screens

Paired chemical-level differences against AnchorBoost, CNP and log-linear interpolation with 10,000-resample percentile intervals (95%, plus 97.5% for the external screens), seed 0, the published convention

expected_before_run.nfa_tnp_mae: 1.10 to 1.28; the comparator may win, tie or lose and every result is retained
expected_before_run.nfa_anchorboost_minus_tnp: -0.05 to +0.05 with an interval that probably crosses zero
expected_before_run.tetnp_versus_tnp: equal or slightly lower error for TE-TNP
expected_before_run.if_the_comparator_wins: report it as the headline of this item and say so in results.md and in the suggested manuscript sentence

verification: verify_tnp.py recomputes every reported mean and interval from the saved per-design prediction arrays through a separate code path that does not import run_tnp.py, and re-derives the AnchorBoost, CNP and interpolation per-chemical values from the frozen published tables.
